messages.author: 3ba9c13174149f8d
messages.subject: Save results
parts:
Hello,

I think it´s just an easy questio to answer but so far, my trials with write.csv, write.tabel and save did not work out.
How can I save results e.g. from summary() or anova() with class "anova.lm.rrpp" into a readable text file? I find it a little bit annoyoing to open every time R if I want to have a look on it.

Thank you!
Best,
Peter

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Save results
parts:
Peter,

You can use capture.output to save any screen-printed result.  You can use the function, save, to save an object that can be reloaded.  You can also just save the entire workspace with save.image.

Mike
